$comment: Evidence manifest (Stage 1 Remediation, spec Крок C). Every evidence citation in protocol/registers.canonical.json's 'evidence' arrays cites a source_id from this file. tools/protocol/lib/semantic-checks.js resolves each citation against this manifest AND the two normalized indices (workbook_index.json, upstream_index.json) — a non-empty locator string is not accepted as proof by itself; the address/claim must actually be present in the corresponding index.

sources.document: 极空BMS RS485 Modbus通用协议(V1.1) — 成都极空科技有限公司 (Chengdu Jikong Technology Co., Ltd), 2024.02, author 张鹏 (Zhang Peng); version history V1.0 (2023.02) → V1.1 (2024.01, "修订部分错误,新增一些寄存器支持" — corrected some errors, added support for some registers).
sources.provenance: User-supplied, stated to be downloaded from the manufacturer's official site. This is the manufacturer's own RS485 Modbus register-map specification — the primary source this project's Modbus register catalog is protocol-verified against. 208 physical register addresses across 4 base blocks (0x1000 settings, 0x1200 measurements/status, 0x1400 device identity/config, 0x1600 commands); this project's PRE-EXISTING 119-register canonical catalog was independently, manually cross-checked address-by-address against this document and found to match at every address (0 conflicts) — see protocol/evidence/IMPLEMENTATION_DRIFT_REVIEW.md and BMS_V2_MANIFEST_EXECUTION_LOG.md for the full cross-check. Confirms 0x111C and 0x1470 (heating thresholds, setup passcode) are genuinely ABSENT from the official V1.1 map — those two addresses fall in undocumented gaps in this document's own table, independently corroborating this project's pre-existing fail-closed classification of both fields. Also documents a real ambiguity in the manufacturer's own table: 0x1600/0x1606 (VoltageCalibration/CurrentCalibration) are typed UINT16 but declared Length=4 — an inconsistency in the primary source itself, not a transcription error downstream.
sources.note: This entry previously had status 'unavailable' — no official document was reachable in this environment. That is no longer true; the user supplied this file directly. 'confirmed_official' verification_status may now be assigned to a field ONLY once its specific claim has actually been checked against this document (not merely because this source is now 'available' in general) — see the per-field manifest built in Stage 3/4 of BMS_V2_MANIFEST_EXECUTION_LOG.md for which fields that applies to.

sources.provenance: User-supplied local file. Exact capture methodology/session log (whether it was produced from a live device read, and by what tool) is NOT independently confirmed in this environment — graded as workbook evidence (not hardware-capture evidence) for that reason.
sources.note: DEPRECATED 2026-09-11 — superseded by workbook_lifepo4_bms_parameters_registers_v2. This V1 workbook covered only 113 of the (now known) 208 official V1.1 physical addresses, carried no origin/verification-status columns, and predates independent confirmation against the real official protocol document. Retained in the repository and in this manifest for historical/reproducibility reasons only — no new claim should cite this source_id going forward. 129 rows total, 117 rows carry a non-empty address cell, 113 unique 0xNNNN address tokens (re-verified 2026-09-09 via build_workbook_index.py, matching the independent review's own count).

sources.provenance: User-supplied local file, restructured relative to the deprecated V1 workbook into 3 sheets ('Реєстр параметрів' — 265 rows/264 addresses, 'Групи UI', 'Аудит'). The register-registry sheet's own 'Статус верифікації'/'Походження даних' columns explicitly cite compliance against official_jk_documentation ('JK BMS RS485 Modbus V1.1') — independently spot-checked address-by-address against that same PDF in this session and found self-consistent (the audit sheet's own claimed counts — 208 V1.1 addresses, 0 missing, 2 vendor-extension addresses 0x111C/0x1470, 4 confirmed-reserved fields, specific unit/address corrections — all reproduced exactly from the raw row data). This is the NORMALIZED SPECIFICATION OF THIS PROJECT'S IMPLEMENTATION going forward: every parameter this project exposes must trace to a row in this sheet; it is not itself the protocol's primary source (that is official_jk_documentation) but is graded above the deprecated V1 workbook because of its explicit origin/verification tracking and its demonstrated (independently spot-checked, not merely claimed) agreement with the primary source.
sources.note: 264 unique physical addresses (210 base addresses ignoring high/low-byte packed suffixes: 208 official V1.1 + 2 vendor extensions 0x111C/0x1470). All 119 of the pre-existing canonical catalog's addresses are present in this sheet (0 missing) plus 91 addresses not yet in that catalog. Access distribution: R=159, RW=97, W=8, calculated(non-register)=1.

sources.commit_message: Add and align cell voltage sensors in JK-PB modbus example (#1013)
sources.provenance: Pinned upstream implementation snapshot at the exact commit recorded by commit_sha; the firmware build uses the same immutable revision.
sources.note: A register present in this index may be (a) a real implemented ESPHome entity (an 'address:' YAML key), which additionally corroborates it was actually read/written by upstream's own firmware, or (b) present ONLY inside upstream's own inline register-table comment with no implementing entity (e.g. 0x12E4 — upstream documents 'BatVol 0.01V' as a comment but never wires an entity to it). Both are recorded as evidence of the ADDRESS/FIELD MEANING claim; only (a) additionally supports an 'implemented upstream too' claim. See each address's entries in upstream_index.json (kind: 'yaml_address_key' marks case (a)). 2026-09-11: demoted to SECONDARY status now that official_jk_documentation is available — this community reverse-engineered YAML is retained as corroborating evidence (it independently agrees with the primary source at addresses both cover) but is no longer the highest-authority available source for any claim it shares with official_jk_documentation.

sources.note: Evidence of what THIS project implements, never proof of protocol correctness on its own (spec section 3, tier 4 — lowest trust). A field with ONLY this source is 'single_source' / 'implementation_only_unverified', never 'confirmed_multiple_sources', regardless of how many places in the implementation happen to agree with each other (batterylifepo4.yaml and jk_bms.js are not independent of one another — both were authored together).

sources.session_scope: Read-only GET/SSE session against jk-bms.local (real device, IP 192.168.27.43 at capture time). No POST/write of any kind was performed.
sources.note: Per Крок C's hardware-evidence rule: a valid decoded number on the wire from this session confirms the register RESPONDS and that the DECODE (scale/sign/unit) produces a plausible physical value — it does NOT by itself confirm write semantics, enum meaning, or any RW claim. Device identity (manufacturer_device_id = 'JK-PB2A16S15P') is a MODEL/hardware-identity claim, not a BMS firmware-version claim — see protocol/registers.canonical.json's version_context block.
